module: Obsolete file: it only writes an error to the log (with the call trace) saying that something tried to use the old outgauge extension, and returns an empty table. The OutGauge protocol is handled elsewhere (see https://go.beamng.com/protocols and the protocols module).
notes: The module returns {}: any function called on it will be nil.
The log error occurs when the file is loaded (require/extensions.load).
